title: Paid Time Off Policy
text: Full-time employees now accrue 25 days of paid time off (PTO) per year, accrued monthly at approximately 2.08 days per month (increased from 20 days as of August 2026). New hires may begin using PTO immediately upon starting - the previous 90-day waiting period has been removed. Up to 10 unused PTO days may be carried over into the following calendar year. PTO requests must be submitted in Workday at least 2 weeks in advance for absences longer than 3 days. PTO is separate from sick leave.
